stage1.impression: A clean, correctly framed three-quarter of the carton speaker's back on a warm grey sweep, with generous copy space and a legible label and port; it reads as a competent CG draft rather than a photograph. The light is soft and nearly frontal, so the white faces read as flat cards, the grey sweep is a little dull, the base is only softly grounded, and a faint straight-edged patch on the floor left of the base looks like an artifact.

blocking_9: The sweep shows no trace of the reflect-only flags: no straight-edged patches on the floor; the floor across the flags' far edges must brighten or stay level toward the camera (falloff <= 0 on [480,708,600,730] and [1150,744,1300,768]; now +3.0 and +2.0).

The side panel reads as modelled lacquer, not a grey card: 12 to 22 levels of falloff from eave to plinth on [756,226,866,672] (now 5.9; p5 to p95 only 188.0 to 200.9), with the red gable triangle above it unchanged.
The amplifier's connections read as parts: highlights on the connector bezels (part:amp-connectors lum_p95 at least 90; now 57.4, below the plate around them at 75.2).

The accent reads as one red across the lit side: back plinth and back roof each within delta E 4 of #C62828 (now 5.2 to 6.7 at (173,38,39)/(166,37,38) and 5.3 at (210,60,61), 9.4 apart: brick at the base, salmon on the roof), without clipping the white top-left of the back (now 247 to 248).

changes.problem: Reflect-only flag 0 lies 5 mm above the floor and the sweep's own gloss sees its unlit underside, so the floor shows a straight-edged parallelogram 3 to 4 levels darker, inside the copy space left of the base.

evidence.measured: Flag 0 projects to (439,801)-(485,714)-(875,714)-(889,801), and that is where the patch is. Far edge, profile y on [480,708,600,730]: 168.2, 168.2, 169.0, 168.0, 165.2, 165.0, 165.2, 165.2 (falloff +3.0, the floor darkening toward the camera; the flag-free previous render reads 173.9 to 176.2 there, falloff -2.3). Near edge on [460,790,620,820]: 171.2 to 175.2 in about 8 px. Left edge on [430,760,500,790]: 172.2 to 169.0 in about 5 px.

change.from: none: every glossy surface sees the flag, the sweep included

changes.expected: A receivers list on set flags, like the one glints have: a reflect-only flag is then seen only by the glossy rays of the listed parts and never by the sweep. The parallelogram goes: across its far edge the floor brightens smoothly toward the camera (falloff -1 to -3, as in the flag-free render), and the soft cast-shadow wedge from the base corner reads on its own. The side plinth keeps its deep red, G and B near 34 to 37 (now 146,34,35). Fallback if receivers cannot be built: park the flag out of every reflection (set.flags.0.center_m z from 0.005 to 3.0). That also removes the patch, at the cost of the side plinth's G and B rising to about 50.

changes.problem: The side panel is one flat value from eave to plinth (falloff 5.9) and reads as a grey card, not lacquer. Its clear coat mirrors (-0.94, 0.33, -0.11): past the sweep's left edge at the top (black, sky strength 0) and the lit floor lower down. That lifts the bottom and cancels the diffuse falloff.

evidence.measured: Profile y on the side white (100% side-right): 196.9, 196.8, 195.9, 194.9, 194.8, 193.8, 192.7, 191.0 (falloff 5.9); p5 to p95 188.0 to 200.9. Over the same height the back panel falls 12.6 (left strip [884,222,912,596], 247.4 to 234.8) and 16.9 (right strip [1052,222,1072,596], 239.4 to 222.5). The previous render, with the side lamp at 0.9952, fell only 10.8 while the side rose 13 levels, so more side lamp mostly brightens the side rather than shaping it.

changes.expected: A soft graduated lacquer sheen on the upper side panel, with no added light anywhere. The first bin rises from 196.9 to about 207 to 212 while the last stays near 191 (falloff 12 to 22). The panel's 0.23 m footprint sits inside its 0.5 m width. Its top edge (z 0.82) maps onto the eave, so the gable triangle above is untouched ([790,170,845,205] stays at lum 57 within 3 levels). Its bottom edge sits at ramp 0, so neither edge shows. The floor mirrors the panel only at the frame's left edge below y 720, at ramp values under 0.15, which adds under 2 levels.

changes.problem: The connectors carry no highlight at all and read as holes in the plate. Glint 0 is meant to fix this but cannot be placed: its occlusion ray hits amp-module at 0.00 m from whichever bezel it starts on, a self-hit, not a real occluder.

evidence.measured: amp-connectors (the bezels) lum_median 51.2, p95 57.4, against the plate around them [990,625,1070,665] at 75.2 (p95 76.5): no connector pixel is brighter than the plate. Glint 0 was skipped on the IEC bezel ([0.591,-0.074,0.189], this render, pixel (1062,642) on amp-connectors) and on the XLR bezel ([0.54,-0.11,0.19], previous render, pixel (1032,646) on amp-connectors), both times with the same reason: amp-module#0 at 0.00 m. Power 2 and 4 both left p95 at 57.4.

change.from: none: amp-module counts as an occluder from 0 m

changes.expected: An engine option on glints: skip the listed parts in the mirror-direction occlusion test, or start the test 1 mm out along the normal. amp-module's faces apparently sit flush with the connector bezels. With it, glint 0 is placed at its current point with its current receivers: a small crisp highlight on the IEC bezel, and on any connector rim that mirrors the lamp. That lifts amp-connectors p95 to 90 to 170 while their median stays near 51 and the plate near 71, so the connections read as moulded parts.

changes.problem: Reflect-only flag 1 does the same on the floor right of the product: a straight edge 2 to 3 levels deep at y about 755, running from the plinth to the frame's right edge, with a fainter near edge at y about 825.

change.from: none: every glossy surface sees the flag, the sweep included

changes.expected: Same mechanism as c1. The floor right of the plinth brightens smoothly toward the camera (falloff -1 to -4). The back plinth keeps G and B near 38 and the amp plate stays near 71, because both still see the flag. Fallback: set.flags.1.center_m z from 0.005 to 3.0.

out_of_scope.request: Render this frame at twice the size (2700 x 1800) or more.
out_of_scope.why: The connections are one of the frame's three purposes, yet the whole connector block is 62 x 19 px (amp-module box [999,638,1061,657]) and the XLR about 14 px across. Even with highlights they cannot resolve on a magazine spread. The card fixes frame size and sampling.
